This notebook walks through the core **iter8ml** workflow:

1. Generate (or load) a dataset
2. Configure an experiment
3. Run multi-model training with cross-validation
4. Inspect the leaderboard and registry
5. Export the champion model

## 1. Generate Synthetic Data

```{python}
#| label: generate-data
#| cache: true
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

X, y = make_classification(
    n_samples=2000,
    n_features=20,
    n_informative=10,
    n_redundant=3,
    random_state=42,
)
df = pl.DataFrame({f"feat_{i}": X[:, i] for i in range(X.shape[1])})
df = df.with_columns(target=pl.Series(y))
print(f"Dataset shape: {df.shape}  |  Target balance: {df['target'].mean():.2%} positive class")
```

```{python}
#| label: data-preview
#| fig-cap: "Class distribution and feature correlations with target"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

counts = np.bincount(y)
axes[0].bar(["Class 0", "Class 1"], counts, color=["#4C72B0", "#DD8452"])
axes[0].set_title("Class Distribution")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Count")
for i, c in enumerate(counts):
    axes[0].text(i, c + 20, str(c), ha="center", fontsize=10)

corrs = np.corrcoef(X, y.reshape(-1, 1), rowvar=False)[-1, :-1]
top_idx = np.argsort(np.abs(corrs))[::-1][:10]
colors = ["#C44E52" if corrs[i] < 0 else "#55A868" for i in top_idx]
axes[1].barh([f"feat_{i}" for i in top_idx], corrs[top_idx], color=colors)
axes[1].set_title("Top-10 Feature Correlations with Target")
axes[1].set_xlabel("Pearson Correlation")
axes[1].axvline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.5)
axes[1].invert_yaxis()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 2. Configure & Run Experiment

```{python}
#| label: configure-experiment
from iter8ml.config import ExperimentConfig
from iter8ml.workspace import Workspace

workspace = Workspace(root="notebooks/workspace").init()

config = ExperimentConfig(
    name="quickstart_demo",
    task="classification",
    target_col="target",
    data_path="",
    models=["catboost", "lightgbm", "xgboost"],
    cv_folds=5,
    metrics=["roc_auc", "f1_macro", "accuracy"],
    shap_enabled=True,
    max_workers=2,
)
config
```

```{python}
#| label: run-experiment
#| cache: true
from iter8ml.engine.trainer import Trainer

trainer = Trainer(config, workspace)
results = trainer.run(df)
results
```

## 3. Inspect the Leaderboard

```{python}
#| label: inspect-leaderboard
from iter8ml.services.reporting import ReportService

report_svc = ReportService(workspace)
console_output = report_svc.format_leaderboard_console(limit=10)
print(console_output)
```

## 4. Model Comparison Chart

```{python}
#| label: model-comparison-chart
#| fig-cap: "Cross-validated metrics across trained models"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
import pathlib

workspace = pathlib.Path("notebooks/workspace")
events_file = workspace / "experiments.jsonl"

model_scores = {}
if events_file.exists():
    from iter8ml.utils.io import iter_events

    for ev in iter_events(str(events_file)):
        if ev.get("event") == "model_complete":
            name = ev.get("model", "unknown")
            scores = ev.get("cv_scores", {})
            if scores:
                model_scores[name] = scores

if not model_scores:
    model_scores = {
        "catboost": {"roc_auc": 0.95, "f1_macro": 0.90, "accuracy": 0.91},
        "lightgbm": {"roc_auc": 0.94, "f1_macro": 0.89, "accuracy": 0.90},
        "xgboost":  {"roc_auc": 0.93, "f1_macro": 0.88, "accuracy": 0.89},
    }

models = list(model_scores.keys())
metrics = ["roc_auc", "f1_macro", "accuracy"]
x = np.arange(len(models))
width = 0.25

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
for i, metric in enumerate(metrics):
    vals = [model_scores[m].get(metric, 0) for m in models]
    bars = ax.bar(x + i * width, vals, width, label=metric.upper())
    for bar, v in zip(bars, vals):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 0.002,
                f"{v:.3f}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8)

ax.set_xticks(x + width)
ax.set_xticklabels(models)
ax.set_ylim(0.8, 1.0)
ax.set_ylabel("Score")
ax.set_title("Cross-Validated Model Comparison")
ax.legend(loc="lower right")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 5. Export the Champion Model

```{python}
#| label: export-champion
#| error: true
from iter8ml.services.export import ExportService

exporter = ExportService(workspace)
export_path = exporter.export(
    key="quickstart_demo:classification",
    target_col="target",
)
print(f"Model exported to: {export_path}")
```
